description: Strategy for resolving the display URL of a full-size image on demand. Called FRESH for every image when the lightbox navigates to it. IMPORTANT: Do NOT cache results — tickets are single-use and will fail on reuse. Built-in implementations (Tempo.Blazor.Models): - DirectImageUrlResolver : imageId IS the URL (default when no resolver provided) - FuncImageUrlResolver : wraps a Func<string, Task<string>> lambda Usage factory: ImageUrlResolvers.Direct() / ImageUrlResolvers.FromFunc(...)
